heading: Theme
intro: The choice follows you on every device.
seasonalHint: Winter, spring, summer and autumn looks switch on by themselves for a few weeks each season. Off unless you turn it on.
lessMotionHint: Stops animations and sliding. Pages change at once instead.
lessMotionDeviceHint: This device already asks for less motion, so it stays on here.
highContrastHint: Plain white pages, black at night, with darker text and edges. The theme stays in buttons and links.
highContrastDeviceHint: This device already asks for more contrast, so it stays on here.
nightNote: Night mode looks the same with every theme.
saved: Saved. Every device you sign in on shows it.
saveFailed: We couldn’t save this on your account, so only this device shows it. Try again later.
